name: Standard power assembly
application: Industrial inverter power assembly; IGBT/SiC-capable module integration
screeningCriteria: Search for manufacturers with comparable power-module assembly capability; technical qualification remains required.

name: High-voltage power assembly
application: High-voltage power assembly for charging power conversion; IGBT/SiC-capable
screeningCriteria: Assess voltage/current class, thermal design, quality systems and production scale before treating any candidate as a substitute.

name: Control board
application: Industrial control PCB/PCBA with embedded microcontroller and power-control interfaces
screeningCriteria: Look for design-and-manufacture capability, industrial quality systems, controller ecosystem and production footprint.

name: DC-link capacitor
application: High-energy DC-link film capacitor for power-electronics applications
screeningCriteria: Fit depends on electrical, thermal, lifetime and packaging requirements; public similarity is only an initial screen.

name: Protective housing
application: Machined/fabricated aluminum enclosure for industrial power electronics
screeningCriteria: Assess material, tolerance, environmental protection, tooling and regional manufacturing capability.

name: Cooling assembly
application: Thermal-management / liquid-cooling assembly for power electronics
screeningCriteria: Assess thermal performance, materials, leak/reliability testing, scale and geographic suitability.

name: Battery-monitoring board
application: Battery-monitoring/control PCBA with sensing and embedded electronics
screeningCriteria: Assess battery-control experience, electronics manufacturing capability, safety/quality systems and production scale.
